subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw adopt third-party passive-capture exports as a first-class durable ingestion source, beginning with Scrollmark canonical bundle v1?
rationale: The implementation would add a permanent source and provenance contract, while current code does not define how producer versions, bundle identity, observation time, completeness, account ownership, retained raw objects, and backup compatibility should behave.

options.title: Approve Scrollmark v1 boundary
options.body: Define the durable provenance and account contracts, then implement only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle before considering legacy formats.

options.title: Approve a broader importer
options.body: Support Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter together, accepting a larger schema-detection and long-term compatibility surface.

options.title: Defer capture imports
options.body: Keep official archives and Birdclaw-owned live transports as the only canonical ingestion sources for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Scrollmark v1 boundary
recommendation.body: Define the durable provenance and account contracts, then implement only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle before considering legacy formats.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant product vision and centralized import architecture are both primarily associated with steipete’s current-main history.
